title: R3 native sessions and authorized project registration; wire revision 3

RemoteV3ApprovalDecisionCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3CancelCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3CommandAccepted.description: Durable inbox admission, not model/execution success. Duplicate immutable commands return the original receipt/event. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3CommandCompleted.description: Not universally task success. Retry completes on durable new execution reference; execute completes on actual terminal Run success/cancellation. Cancel/pause/resume require confirmed structured control result. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3CommandFailed.description: Failure after admission. A refused control is distinct from unconfirmed cancellation; do not infer that an Agent process has stopped. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3CommandRejected.description: Pre-admission rejection only. An expired sequenced submit consumes its ordered slot without execution. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3CommandWithdrawalCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3ControlObserved.description: D41: unconfirmed leaves command accepted and pending reconciliation. Run-scoped controls include resultRef/executionStatus. Before a Run exists (withdrawal reconciliation), omit both rather than invent an identity or execution state. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3ConversationGap.description: Worker requests missing commands or skip records. Never run a later user message across a sequence gap.

RemoteV3ConversationSkip.description: Durable ordered tombstone for a never-dispatched submit. Not an execution/control command; cannot be used to erase accepted work. Retain until gap replay/snapshot acknowledgement is safe.

RemoteV3EventAck.description: Only advances after event persistence AND projection/browser-outbox commit; old store ack never trims new store outbox.

RemoteV3OmittedEvents.description: Worker local event seq continuity without publishing local-only history. Covers inclusive [firstSeq,seq], firstSeq<=seq. Opaque tombstone only, no local conversation/path/model data. Cannot cover any already published event or remote-critical event; immutable bounded ranges are replayed whole. Persist range coverage before advancing contiguous ack.

RemoteV3PauseCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3ProgressEvent.description: Sanitized observable progress only. Never private model reasoning, raw provider auth, full environment, or credential files.

RemoteV3ResumeCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3RetryCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3RunStateEvent.description: Worker creates/binds LocalRun and execution Task using existing semantics; it does not invent long-lived Task or retryOfRunId.

RemoteV3RunSubmitCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3ServerHeartbeat.description: Heartbeat acknowledgement is not event ack. After 45 seconds without authenticated Worker traffic mark offline without modifying execution state.

RemoteV3SkipRecorded.description: Worker records ordered skip in the same durable inbox ordering ledger as submits.

RemoteV3WorkerHeartbeat.description: Sent every 15 seconds. It reports liveness only, not durable business-event progress.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol package semantic version for diagnostics only. Never negotiate or reject based on this value.

RemoteV3WorkerHello.description: First frame after device-authenticated WSS. Same store preserves seq across boots; new store requires null ack. Credentials never appear in frames.

pendingCommandCursor.description: Opaque owner/resource-scoped server cursor; never a Worker seq or cross-owner resource selector.

RemoteV3WorkerHelloAck.description: Frozen delivery requires a reason. Store changes or ack regression require reconciliation; R1 exposes no automatic force-unfreeze API.

supportedWireRevisions.description: Server supported wire revisions, mandatory on rejection (including REMOTE_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED). Initially [1]; during upgrades advertise N and N-1.

RemoteV3CommandReceived.description: For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3DeliveryGrant.description: Explicit durable execution permission. Continuous event ACK is never permission. Late unconsumed grants expire; persisted grants are not reverted by server timers. For native.import/workspace.register omit conversationId and correlate immutable commandId/digest. Existing conversation commands still require it; Worker validates against persisted command.

RemoteV3ConversationUpdateCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

RemoteV3ControlConfirmed.description: D41: Worker-only structured evidence, never parsed error text. Empty orphanProcessIds is not proof of no remaining process. A paused process may still exist.

RemoteV3ConversationCreateCommand.description: Immutable, owner-derived command identity. Only run.submit has conversationSeq. Deduplicate commandId plus exact normalized content; never execute twice.

syncGeneration.description: Deletion-fence generation. Reset retires content generations up to this value; conversation deletion additionally restricts the local conversation ID. Never cover later generations or seq >= deletionSeq.

RemoteV3ContentRedaction.description: Authenticated privacy coverage control, not a replacement immutable event. Bound to a durable reset/deletion fence. No new seq allocation; normal contiguous ACK only after all covered identities/digests and deletion are committed. native.index.deleted fences only that nativeSessionId; imported deletes the index, never the newly imported Hub conversation. sync.reset covers both kinds. No redaction of closure confirmation audit.

RemoteV3SyncConversation.description: Worker local identifiers. Server namespaces by worker/store and maps browser IDs; visibility is display-only. Missing conversationKind means scenario (requires existing scene fields). Native requires agentType/nativeSessionId and omits scene fields; exact vendor session binding remains local.

RemoteV3CatalogView.description: Atomic bounded complete catalog for R1. Reject oversized catalogs instead of truncating; offline entries are last observed, not proof that paths still exist. Revision 3 producers include authorizedRoots, [] when none; omitted legacy HTTP field means no remote project browsing.

RemoteWire3Error.description: Sanitized error. No credential, raw environment, owner locator or arbitrary detail object.

RemoteWire3ErrorCode.description: Frozen revision 3 code set. Excludes HTTP-only PAT/suspension codes; future public registry extensions cannot silently widen this domain.

RemoteWire3ApprovalView.description: Local Worker policy is authoritative. Mandatory blocked actions are git_push/deploy/delete/db_migrate plus locally declared actions; refusal reason code REMOTE_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN. Rejection of a dangerous action may still be submitted remotely.

RemoteV3RedactedSlot.description: Only retired content slots, never admission/grant/control facts. Original identity and digest are retained, not rewritten.

NativeActivityEvidence.description: Unknown is read-only. Positive matching live process or post-confirmation changes invalidate confirmation; absence alone never proves closure.

NativeFormatView.description: readable requires a tested version/profile readerId. unsupported requires sanitized reason; never guess a format.

NativeSessionIndex.description: Worker-local opaque index ID, not a path or fuzzy CLI ID. Exact vendor ID is kept in the local binding. Redact before title truncation. No body, tool arguments or process IDs in index.

RemoteNativeSessionView.description: Owner-scoped public IDs mapped from Worker/store index. Offline metadata is stale evidence, never write permission.

NativeMessagePart.description: Normalized/filtered content only. A large message may span pages, with stable hash and ID. No reasoning, instruction prompts, raw tool arguments/results or attachments.

NativeMessagePage.description: Ephemeral page <=1MiB encoded UTF-8. Newest messages first, segments within a message ascending. Do not render an incomplete message. before continues exclusively after the last part in this order.

NativeReadInput.description: Exact Worker index ID; limit is message parts, default 50 at HTTP boundary. Snapshot cursor bound to file identity/immutable cut and 15-minute expiry. sourceRevision is optional: initial reads capture current source; before alone pins the older snapshot cut. If both are supplied they must match. Server must not substitute the latest index revision for a cursor-bound revision.

RemoteNativeImportInput.description: Explicit audited closure confirmation, not permission to override a detected live process. Import copies history and binds exact vendor ID; never starts a model by itself.

NativeClosureConfirmation.description: Server-generated from authenticated explicit user action, persisted by Worker at admission and bound to source revision. No caller-supplied owner ID.

RemoteAuthorizedRoot.description: Opaque local grant identity. Full absolute root path is never exported.

LocalAuthorizedRootInput.description: Only authenticated local API. Existing IDs kept; new IDs allocated by computer. No UNC/device namespaces; canonical path required.

LocalAuthorizedRootsView.description: Default roots=[] and version=1. Roots can only be configured on this computer.

LocalAuthorizedRootsInput.description: Atomic replace with CAS. Removed root IDs never reused; changed grants invalidate selection tokens immediately.

DirectoryListingInput.description: Missing directoryToken selects root itself. No path input. Default limit 50. Opaque signed Worker tokens bind root/version/store/real directory identity.

DirectoryEntry.description: Directories only; no files, full path, recursive children or raw error details.

DirectoryListingPage.description: One directory level, <=100 entries, <=1MiB JSON. Cursor pins listing identity/order and expires in 15 minutes. Recheck real paths for each entry.

RemoteWorkspaceRegisterInput.description: Register existing selected folder, not mkdir or init-git. Validate real path again at grant; identical local registration checks, including legitimate non-Git read-only workspaces.

RemoteResourceQueuedReceipt.description: HTTP202 transport receipt only. No fabricated conversationId/runId or execution sequence. Poll existing GET /commands/{commandId}; authoritative result comes from Worker.

RemoteResourceResultRef.description: workspace.register requires workspaceId only; native.import requires workspaceId/conversationId/nativeSessionId. IDs local on wire, owner-scoped in HTTP. No fake Task or Run.

NativeContinuationConfirmationInput.description: Explicit renewed attestation if imported conversation detects external changes. Never override positive live-process evidence.

RemoteV3RunSubmitPayload.description: Scenario retains sceneId/sceneVersion. Native requires conversationKind=native, agentType/nativeSessionId matching persisted binding and sessionMode=continue; omits scene fields. Confirmation optional only when an existing audited confirmation remains valid. No fuzzy IDs or new-session fallback.
